title: Laravel Herd 2: Coding Agents, Workspaces, and Cloud Deploys
content:
Laravel Herd 2.0 adds Herd Studio for running coding agents on local sites, git workspaces for parallel work, and Laravel Cloud deploys.

The post Laravel Herd 2: Coding Agents, Workspaces, and Cloud Deploys appeared first on Laravel News.
